verdict.rationale: Meltano documents incremental replication state tracking so pipelines resume from the last recorded state instead of restarting from scratch (meltano-docs-20, meltano-docs-30), which addresses interrupted-sync resumption. However, there is no first-party or community evidence of automatic retry logic for transient failures (e.g., network blips, API rate limits) or configurable retry policies. missing for 10: documented automatic retry-on-transient-failure mechanism, evidence of retry configuration/backoff settings, and independent/hands-on confirmation that checkpoint resume works reliably in production.
